experience.lesson: A prior C02 model attempt made 10 source reads, no patch and no test attempt; the host stopped repeated actions without progress. Use the supplied focus and current hashes to make a bounded edit before requesting further unchanged source.

instruction: Fix WarmS03Cache._read: its insertion deadline currently uses now captured before recall and final revision callbacks. A slow successful fill is inserted already expired. Compute insertion expiry from a fresh time.monotonic() inside the insertion lock, after final revision validation. Keep the existing expiry check on cache lookup. Preserve revocation tickets, callbacks outside the lock, deep-copy isolation, scope/revision/limit keys and byte accounting. Change only the editable source; keep all tests immutable. Use the supplied focus directly, make the small code edit, then run the existing verifier. This is a source patch; do not claim original 3A03 or live S03 acceptance.
